R851.note: Verified by compiling and running the exact fixed exec(String[]{"cmd.exe","/c","dir",data}) on Windows: a data value containing an embedded double-quote (e.g. foo" & echo INJECTED & echo ") breaks out of the Windows argv quoting and cmd.exe still executes the injected command, so the Windows branch is not actually closed.

R852.note: Replaces exec entirely with java.nio.file (Files.list/toRealPath), eliminating any shell; output is never returned to the HTTP caller either way so the fix is behavior-preserving.

R853.note: offset > capacity || length > capacity - offset correctly rejects out-of-bounds writes without underflow and still allows valid nonzero-offset writes, matching the stated contract.

R854.note: Generic client message plus server-side log.Printf is the standard fix; no other behavior changed.

R855.note: .RequireAuthorization() is the correct, minimal fix for a Minimal API endpoint; no other behavior altered.

R856.note: Allowlist keys ('foo','bar','dashboard') are hardcoded to the test's literal sample value rather than derived from any real destination set, so in production this would reject virtually every legitimate redirect target; the restriction is stated as an allowlist but the shape is overfit to the sample input rather than a generalizable relative-path/host check.

R857.note: secure=True closes the sink; samesite='Lax' addition is disclosed and does not block the legitimate flow.

R858.note: Explicit CsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler is Spring's documented fix for the cookie-to-header SPA CSRF pattern, but the write-up doesn't disclose that this also disables the default XOR/BREACH-masking protection that was previously in effect.

R859.note: Logs full exception server-side via app.logger, returns a generic client message; no other behavior changed.

R860.note: ODBC '?' placeholder with Parameters.Add correctly parameterizes the value while preserving the LIKE wildcard search behavior.

R861.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterizes both tenantId and the composed '%term%' value; nested interpolated string is valid C# and preserves the contains-search and empty-term semantics per the stated contract.

R862.note: Content-type sniffing + allowlist + random filename correctly closes CWE-434, but avatar_lookup.go (the read path) is left completely unedited; the write-up does state openly that callers must switch to the generated filename, which is why this is a 1 rather than a 0.

R863.note: Denylist pre-check plus toRealPath()/startsWith() containment check is a standard, correct path-traversal fix; existing 404-on-missing-file behavior is preserved.

R864.note: gorilla/sessions store.New() still decodes an existing session cookie from the request and sets IsNew=false exactly like store.Get() does, so swapping Get for New does not regenerate the session identifier - this is a no-op fix that leaves the fixation vector open.

R865.note: Escaping control chars/line separators/backslash plus a message-template placeholder closes CRLF log injection; benign usernames render unchanged.

R866.note: HttpUtility.HtmlEncode() on the interpolated value is the correct context-appropriate encoding; no other behavior changed.

R867.note: Never instructs removing/replacing the original vulnerable @GetMapping("/account/delete") in AccountController.java when introducing a separate AccountDeletionController mapped to the same GET path, so applying the fix as written yields a duplicate route (Spring ambiguous-mapping failure) or leaves the original vulnerable GET endpoint reachable; not flagged in the write-up.
